title: Repair curation design
description: 09-curation. Signed feed head (sequence + chained hash) - CDN can currently withhold/rollback/blank. Perceptual matching cannot work via exact-match Bloom/shards: ship local datasets or drop Bloom for perceptual types; define Chromaprint/TMK/SimHash formats or remove. PDQ example 32 hex vs 64. Bloom size off ~10x (10M => ~12.5MB). Shard path reveals full hash. ordinal semantics contradictory. key_id embedding contradicts Ch 34. CSAM: hash lists are not publishable; US 2258A requires reporting not scanning; public PDQ list is an evasion oracle; evidence-preservation duty. Bloom hash function unspecified.
notes: From esol.4: CurationEntry and AuthorityDeclaration signatures -> attached JWS (Ch 34), corundumType CurationEntry / AuthorityDeclaration; remove canonical-JSON signing text (09:319, 09:408) and the {algorithm,key_id,value} signature object.
close_reason: Signed feed head with hash chain + expiry; exact-match Bloom/buckets only for sha256, PDQ via full dataset; unspecifiable hash types removed; Bloom construction specified; legal/* feeds restricted (RFC 9421 auth); ordinal 0..1; JWS signatures; CSAM/2258A claims corrected.
